description_en: Retrieves the name of an approved digital SMS signature
description_zh: 获取数字短信签名通过的签名name
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-digital-sign-by-name --sign-name '阿里云数字商城' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDigitalSignByName

parameters.help_en: Required. The name of the signature. It must be a digital SMS signature that has been applied for under the current account
parameters.help_zh: 必填，签名名称。必须是本账号已申请的数字短信签名
parameters.name: sign_name

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en: The request status code. A value of OK indicates success, and other values indicate error codes
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
OK代表成功，其他为错误码

Data.description_en:
gmtModified: The last modification time.
creator: The ID of the creator.
signName: The name of the SMS signature.
qualificationId: The qualification ID, which is the ID of the qualification created by using the API operation or the console.
signIndustry: The industry type. Valid values: 0: General (GENERAL). 1: E-commerce and retail (ECOMMERCE).
signVersion: The signature version. The number is updated upon version iteration. The current value is 1.
telecomRegisterStatus: The registration status with China Telecom. Valid values: 0: Registration failed. 3: Registration succeeded. -1: Registering. -2: Not registered.
signCode: The code of the SMS signature.
gmtCreate: The creation time.
signId: The signature ID, which is the unique identifier of the signature in the system.
mobileRegisterStatus: The registration status with China Mobile.
SignSource: The source of the signature. Valid values: 0: The full name or abbreviation of an enterprise or institution. 2: The full name or abbreviation of an app. 5: The full name or abbreviation of a trademark. 7: E-commerce or flagship store (this type can only be created by using the API operation).
mobileAvailableStatus: The availability on China Mobile. Valid values: 0: Unavailable. 1: Available. When creating a template or sending a digital SMS message, select an available signature whenever possible.
unicomRegisterStatus: The registration status with China Unicom. Valid values: 0: Registration failed. 3: Registration succeeded. -1: Registering. -2: Not registered.
unicomAvailableStatus: The availability on China Unicom. Valid values: 0: Unavailable. 1: Available. When creating a template or sending a digital SMS message, select an available signature whenever possible.
telecomAvailableStatus: The availability on China Telecom. Valid values: 0: Unavailable. 1: Available. When creating a template or sending a digital SMS message, select an available signature whenever possible
Data.description_zh:
gmtModified：最后修改时间 。
creator：创建者ID。
signName：短信签名名称 。
qualificationId：资质ID，接口或控制台创建的资质ID。
signIndustry：行业类型。0：通用（GENERAL）；1：电商零售（ECOMMERCE）。
signVersion：签名版本，若有版本迭代会更新数字，当前为1
telecomRegisterStatus：电信报备状态。0, "报备失败"；3, "报备成功"；-1, "报备中"；-2, "未报备"。
signCode：短信签名 Code。
gmtCreate：创建时间。
signId：签名ID，系统内唯一签名标识。
mobileRegisterStatus：移动报备状态 。
SignSource：签名来源。取值：
0：企事业单位的全称或简称。
2：App 应用的全称或简称。
5：商标名的全称或简称。
7：电商、旗舰店（仅接口可创建此类型）
mobileAvailableStatus：移动可用性。0, "不可用"；1, "可用"。创建模板或发送数字短信时请尽可能选择“可用”签名。
unicomRegisterStatus：联通报备状态。0, "报备失败"；3, "报备成功"；-1, "报备中"；-2, "未报备"。
unicomAvailableStatus：联通可用性。0, "不可用"；1, "可用"。创建模板或发送数字短信时请尽可能选择“可用”签名。
telecomAvailableStatus：电信可用性。0, "不可用"；1, "可用"。创建模板或发送数字短信时请尽可能选择“可用”签名

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: Successful. false: Failed
